    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

DocFileHandler.read_text:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads the document file from self.file_path and returns the full text of the document as a single string with each paragraph separated by a newline." read_text]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "The combined text of all paragraphs in the document, joined by newline characters."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a Document object from self.file_path and assign it to doc. RESULT doc]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list and assign it to text. RESULT text]
            [COMMAND For each paragraph in doc.paragraphs, append paragraph.text to the text list, preserving the order of paragraphs and including empty paragraph texts. RESULT text]
            [COMMAND Join the elements of text using a newline character as the separator and return the resulting string. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DocFileHandler.write_text:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Writes the given text into a Word document at the configured file path with the specified font size and alignment, returning True on success or False if any exception occurs." write_text]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> content </REF>: string "The text content to write into the Word document."
        <REF> font_size </REF>: int "The font size in points to apply to the written text, defaults to 12."
        <REF> alignment </REF>: string "The alignment name to be mapped to a paragraph alignment value, defaults to 'left'."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if the document is created, formatted, and saved successfully; False if any exception occurs during the process."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND In the try block, create a new Document object and assign it to doc. RESULT doc]
            [COMMAND Add a new paragraph to doc and assign it to paragraph. RESULT paragraph]
            [COMMAND Add a run to paragraph containing content and assign it to run. RESULT run]
            [COMMAND Get the font object from run and assign it to font. RESULT font]
            [COMMAND Set font.size to Pt(font_size). RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Call self._get_alignment_value(alignment) and assign the result to alignment_value. RESULT alignment_value]
            [COMMAND Set paragraph.alignment to alignment_value. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Save the document to self.file_path by calling doc.save(self.file_path). RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Return True to indicate success. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Any exception occurs during document creation, paragraph or run creation, font size assignment, alignment mapping, paragraph alignment assignment, or saving the document.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Catch the exception and return False to indicate failure. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DocFileHandler.add_heading:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds a heading at the specified level to the Word document referenced by self.file_path, saves the document, and returns True; if any exception occurs, returns False." add_heading]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> heading </REF>: string "The heading text to add to the document."
        <REF> level </REF>: int "The heading level to use; defaults to 1."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True if the heading was added and the document was saved successfully; False if an exception occurred."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, create a Document object from self.file_path and bind it to doc. RESULT doc]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, add the heading at the specified level to the document by calling doc.add_heading(heading, level). RESULT doc]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, save the modified document back to self.file_path by calling doc.save(self.file_path). RESULT doc]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, return True to signal success. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If any exception is raised while creating the Document, adding the heading, or saving the document.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False to signal failure. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DocFileHandler.add_table:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds a table to the Word document at self.file_path, populates it with the provided data, saves the document, and returns True, or returns False if any exception occurs." add_table]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> data </REF>: list of list "Two-dimensional data whose values are converted to strings and placed into table cells."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return value </REF>: boolean "True if the table was added, populated, and saved successfully; False if any exception occurred."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Open the Word document located at self.file_path by creating a Document object. RESULT doc]
            [COMMAND Add an empty table to doc with row count equal to len(data) and column count equal to len(data[0]), reading data[0] immediately so an empty data list raises an exception. RESULT table]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over each row index i and row from enumerate(data), begin processing the row. RESULT row_iteration_context]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over row i, for each column index j and cell_value from enumerate(row), assign str(cell_value) to table.cell(i, j).text. RESULT fill_cell]
            [COMMAND Save the modified document to self.file_path. RESULT saved_doc]
            [COMMAND Return True to indicate success. RESULT success_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: An exception occurs inside the try block while opening the document, creating the table, filling cells, or saving the document.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Catch the exception and return False to indicate failure. RESULT failure_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DocFileHandler._get_alignment_value:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Maps a case-insensitive alignment name to the corresponding WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT enum value, defaulting to LEFT when the name is not recognized." _get_alignment_value]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> alignment </REF>: str "Alignment name to convert; case-insensitive."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT "The matching paragraph alignment enum value, or WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT.LEFT if the alignment name is unknown."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Build the alignment_options dictionary mapping 'left', 'center', and 'right' to the corresponding WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT enum constants. RESULT alignment_options]
            [COMMAND Normalize the alignment input to lowercase and retrieve its mapped value from alignment_options, using WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT.LEFT as the default when the key is absent. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
